name: Rhubarb Wine
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: sugar to every gallon of wine
ingredients.originalText: 4 pounds sugar to every gallon of wine

ingredients.name: isinglass dissolved in a little hot water
ingredients.originalText: 1/2 ounce isinglass dissolved in a little hot water

ingredients.name: rum to every gallon of wine
ingredients.originalText: 1 gill of rum to every gallon of wine

instructions.text: To every pint of rhubarb cut in pieces add 1 pint of boiling water
Let it stand a week, stirring it once every day
Strain and add 4 pounds sugar to every gallon of wine, 1 ounce whole ginger, the juice of 1 lemon, 7 cayenne pods, 1/2 ounce isinglass dissolved in a little hot water
Let it stand 2 weeks to ferment
Strain again and add 1 gill of rum to every gallon of wine

source.originalInstructions:
1. To every pint of rhubarb cut in pieces add 1 pint of boiling water
2. Let it stand a week, stirring it once every day
3. Strain and add 4 pounds sugar to every gallon of wine, 1 ounce whole ginger, the juice of 1 lemon, 7 cayenne pods, 1/2 ounce isinglass dissolved in a little hot water
4. Let it stand 2 weeks to ferment
5. Strain again and add 1 gill of rum to every gallon of wine
6. Bottle
originalIngredients: 4 pounds sugar to every gallon of wine
1/2 ounce isinglass dissolved in a little hot water
1 gill of rum to every gallon of wine
